raw.details:
IDEAS 4.0 × AI Tech Ideathon:

Your Idea. Your Code. Your Creation.

Get ready for 24 hours of innovation, creativity, and AI-powered problem-solving at IDEAS 4.0 × AI Tech Ideathon, organised by K.R. Mangalam University.

Bring your ideas to life, collaborate with passionate innovators, and develop solutions that can make a real-world impact. Showcase your technical skills, creativity, and problem-solving abilities in this AI-focused competition.

Event Details:

  • Event Dates: 27–28 October 2026
  • Duration: 24 Hours
  • Theme: Artificial Intelligence (AI)
  • Team Size: 2–5 Members
  • Total Prize Pool: ₹1,00,000

Competition Structure:

Round 1: Online Idea Submission

  • Register your team on Unstop.

  • Submit your AI-based project idea, including the problem statement, proposed solution, innovation, and technology stack.

  • Ideas will be evaluated based on innovation, feasibility, relevance, and technical approach.

  • Only shortlisted teams will be invited to participate in the offline round on campus.

Round 2: Offline AI Tech Ideathon

  • Shortlisted teams will be invited to K.R. Mangalam University for the offline event.

  • The official problem statement will be released one day before the event.

  • Teams will have 24 hours to develop and demonstrate their solutions.

  • Teams must build their projects on the spot and present their solutions for evaluation.

Prize Pool:

  • 1st Prize: ₹50,000
  • 2nd Prize: ₹30,000
  • 3rd Prize: ₹20,000

Total Prize Pool: ₹1,00,000

Why Participate?

  • Compete for cash prizes worth ₹1,00,000.
  • Build AI-powered solutions to real-world challenges.
  • Showcase your technical expertise and creativity.
  • Collaborate with like-minded innovators.
  • Gain valuable project-building and presentation experience.

Important Guidelines:

  • Each team must consist of 2–5 members.
  • All registration details must be accurate and complete.
  • Submitted ideas and developed solutions must be original.
  • Registration does not guarantee selection for the offline round.
  • Only shortlisted teams will receive further instructions regarding payment, venue, and reporting time.
  • The organising committee's decisions regarding shortlisting and evaluation will be final.
